design_philosophy.concept: Institutional Bloomberg Terminal meets Modern Precision SaaS
forbidden_patterns: No generic AI purple/violet gradients (#7351B7 or similar)
No rounded-3xl toy-like SaaS card aesthetic
No Inter or generic sans for key headings and analytical overlines
No ungrounded metric cards without trace lineage indicators
No transparent dropdown or navigation backgrounds
fusion_influences: Swiss Grid & Financial Ticker precision (tabular lining numerals, crisp 1px borders)
Institutional Terminal command center ergonomics (obsidian canvas, high density, dark slate layers)
Forensic Audit lineage (amber/emerald deterministic signals, pinpoint row-level provenance tooltips)

theme.rationale: Financial diligence analysts and growth investors examine dense cohort grids, multi-currency revenue lines, and CRM pipelines over long sessions. A deep Obsidian/Graphite theme paired with crisp contrast reduces eye strain and reinforces the institutional terminal gravity.

source_reference.deterministic_rule: Sum of active recurring contract lines * FX_USD
(Ending ARR Cohort - Churn + Expansions) / Starting ARR Cohort
Contract cancellations & down-sells divided by base ARR
(Prior Q S&M Expense) / (Net New ARR * Gross Margin 76%)
Median(Closed_Date - Deal_Created_Date) for closed won stage
Closed Won count / (Closed Won + Closed Lost count)

hover_provenance_spec.interaction: On cursor hover over any number, a pinned inspection popover appears with 1px border (#38BDF8), showing exact file name, sheet tab, row coordinates, deterministic formula, and an 'Inspect Source Rows' action button.

4. Billing & Terms Calibration (Annual upfront vs monthly in-advance, churn recognition rules)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Structure the application around 4 primary tabs: 'Audit Management' (list, create, delete audits), 'Data Ingestion & Mapping' (multi-file upload, field mapper, FX rates, terms), 'Growth Dashboard' (KPIs with provenance hover, segment breakdown, cohort retention heatmap, stacked MRR and trajectory charts), and 'Forensic Diagnostics & Missing Data' (uncomputable metrics with unlocking prerequisites).

2. Ensure EVERY metric number on the dashboard includes the interactive provenance hover card (data-testid='provenance-hover-{metric-id}'). When hovered, it must reveal the exact file name, sheet tab, row boundaries, and deterministic mathematical formula used.
3. Use JetBrains Mono or monospace font for all financial figures, cohort retention percentages, dates, and currency values with tabular-nums.

4. Implement mock initial audits (e.g. 'Apex Cloud Corp — Series B Diligence', 'OmniData Systems — Growth Buyout Review', 'Vanguard SaaS — Q3 Checkup') with preloaded deterministic data so the user can immediately experience the interactive lineage and cohort heatmap without needing to upload files first.

5. In the Upload & Mapping Wizard, provide functional mock file upload with auto-mapped fields, an editable dropdown for each field, currency selector (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY), and dynamic missing-data notifications when key fields are deliberately unmapped.
6. Adhere strictly to the dark institutional palette (#0B0F17 base, #111726 cards, #1E293B borders) with crisp emerald, amber, and sky blue accents. Avoid purple SaaS gradients entirely.
7. Include all required data-testid attributes listed in interactive_states_and_testing for automated test durability.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.component_reuse: Prioritize using existing primitives from src/components/ui/ (Dialog, Tabs, Popover, DropdownMenu, HoverCard, Tooltip, Sonner toasts). Override fixed h-9 heights where appropriate.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG AA contrast against slate-900 backgrounds. Always provide explicit hover text colors.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use Sonner for user actions (Audit created, File mapped, FX rate updated, Audit exported).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous internal padding (p-5 or p-6 in cards, p-8 in wizard panels) to prevent border collisions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion: Use crisp micro-interactions via framer-motion (0.15s - 0.2s duration) with smooth opacity/transform transitions.
